content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Shipboard Tactical Communications (budget line 3010) is a U.S. Navy procurement program, with funding split across the Other Procurement, Navy and Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy accounts.", "citation": {"fact_id": "50e91b254cc569c8"}}, {"text": "The program procures and installs Integrated Waveform (IW) and Mobile User Objective System (MUOS) Digital Modular Radio (DMR) systems and upgrade kits, which are the components needed to give formerly fielded systems the IW and MUOS capability.", "citation": {"fact_id": "4bdb0b896d255558"}}, {"text": "The DMR is a four-channel software-defined radio that provides 18 satellite-communications and line-of-sight waveforms across the high-, very-high-, and ultra-high-frequency spectrum, delivering primary command-and-control communications to surface, submarine, and shore facilities.", "citation": {"fact_id": "4bdb0b896d255558"}}, {"text": "This DMR variant supports the IW/MUOS capability that replaces the end-of-life UHF Follow-On (UFO) satellite constellation, which the aging legacy UHF SATCOM constellation cannot be relied upon to sustain past its projected end-of-life dates.", "citation": {"fact_id": "4bdb0b896d255558"}}, {"text": "Funding also covers NSA-mandated cryptographic modernization, including the Advanced Cryptographic Capability upgrade for HAIPE platforms and the MUOS waveform 3.2 requirement, plus DMR enhancements for Dynamic Local Scanning and SINCGARS upgrades.", "citation": {"fact_id": "4bdb0b896d255558"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total FY2026 funding across both accounts is $2,620,900 thousand (about $2.62 billion), a large jump from its FY2024 actual level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "21956c874a3b2de1"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $528,574 thousand (about $529 million) across its accounts, so the FY2026 request is roughly five times that execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d5160b29cda17c29"}}, {"text": "The Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy portion carries essentially all of the growth: its FY2026 total of $2,600,000 thousand (about $2.60 billion) is entirely reconciliation (mandatory) funding.", "citation": {"fact_id": "cbefae17cc3ad571"}}, {"text": "That Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy line was enacted at $1,581,121 thousand (about $1.58 billion) in FY2025, so the FY2026 mandatory request adds more than a billion dollars on that account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3a86271300eb7ae4"}}, {"text": "The Other Procurement, Navy portion is far smaller, with an FY2026 discretionary request of $20,900 thousand (about $20.9 million), down from $24,602 thousand enacted in FY2025.", "citation": {"fact_id": "792e73cb39a3e4a0"}}, {"text": "That Other Procurement, Navy request was trimmed by $0.870 million for Advisory and Assistance Services under Executive Order 14222 and by $0.620 million for civilian personnel under Executive Order 14210, both tied to the administration's Department of Government Efficiency initiatives.", "citation": {"fact_id": "dfce633066b9aa97"}}, {"text": "In practical terms, the FY2026 Other Procurement, Navy request funds procurement of six DMR IW and MUOS afloat radios and one upgrade kit for later installation, plus installation of radios and a kit procured in FY2024.", "citation": {"fact_id": "dfce633066b9aa97"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Navy, drawing funding from both the Other Procurement, Navy and Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy appropriations.", "citation": {"fact_id": "57533d40d9857d77"}}, {"text": "The National Security Agency (NSA) shapes the program's requirements, having directed all HAIPE platforms to upgrade to the Advanced Cryptographic Capability and mandated cryptographic modernization for the MUOS waveform 3.2.", "citation": {"fact_id": "4bdb0b896d255558"}}, {"text": "Fleet Commanders formally specify the IW/MUOS capability as a threshold requirement for global maritime command, control, and communications in a Distributed Maritime Environment.", "citation": {"fact_id": "4bdb0b896d255558"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
